title: 第15章 孙奶奶

content_zh:
“还敢狡辩！”没成想，这名阴差根本不相信我说的话，扬起鞭子又打在我身上打了一记，黑着脸，虎视眈眈的喝道：“小鬼头，你知道这是哪儿吗？这是黄泉路，活人怎么能到来这里，这是给死人走的路！既然来了，就别想着回去了！”
说完，他狠狠的踢了我一脚，咒骂道：“给本大爷老实点，赶紧上路，别浪费我的时间，如果这些鬼魂投胎耽误了时辰被阎王爷知道，你我都吃不了兜着走！愣着干什么？还不赶快起来！”
被那名阴差连打带骂之下，我心中极为畏惧，特别是它手中的那根鞭子，就好像我的克星，打在我身上深入灵魂一样疼痛，我真怕他再给我一鞭子，把我给抽的晕了过去。
我抹了一把眼泪，只好强忍着身上的痛楚，扶着地面踉跄的站起身，低着头走进了人群，跟着它们缓缓向鬼门关方向走去。
那两名阴差见我还算识相，冷眼看了我一下，继续提着白灯笼在前面为鬼魂们引路。
我一边走着，一边打量着前面的两名阴差，如果有机会，我还是打算趁他们不备逃之夭夭，那鬼门关，说什么也不能进去，就算被它们手中的鞭子在抽一次，也在所不惜。
我跟着这群鬼魂又走了一会儿之后，黄泉路到了尽头，前方出现了一个黑黝黝的关口，这关口就像古代的城门一样，清一色的黑砖砖砌成，因为年头久远的缘故，城墙满是沧桑，并且上面还长满密密麻麻，绿油油的石苔，看上去就好像有好几千年之久了。
到了这里，我发现关口前面也出现了许多的人群，正排着队依次通过关口。
关口两侧分别站着两名士兵，手里拿着长枪，穿着灰色兵役袍服，胸口绣着一个大大的“兵”字，看上去就好像是古装剧里的士兵一样，不需说，这二人肯是比阴差高一等级的阴兵了。
这时我又抬头看了一眼关口上方，只见城墙上方挂着一面漆黑的大牌匾，上写着“鬼门关”三个血红大字很是醒目。
此时人群排着队伍依次进入关口，每当一个人走到关口都会拿出一份黄纸交给守门的阴兵，这纸长三尺，宽二尺，上面印有“为酆都天子阎罗大帝发给路引”和“天下人必备此引。”
当时我根本不知道这黄纸所谓何物，后来听我师傅讲起，才知道，这张毫不起眼的黄纸是进入地府的路引，因为鬼门关是进入地府的必经关卡，无论是谁来到这里都必须接受检查，看看是否持有地府的通行证“路引。”
这是人死后之魂到阴曹地府报到的凭证，拿着它方能到地府转世轮回，据说人死后需要到当地“城隍爷”，“酆都县太爷”那里领取路引，就好比咱们阳世开的证明一样，需要各个地方给你做手续，盖章才能生效。
我小心翼翼的四周打量了几眼，看看能不能找个机会逃跑，不过提着白灯笼的那两名阴差好像对我格外在意，时不时的向我这里看来，瞪着眼睛死死的盯着我，根本不给我一点逃跑的机会。
我发现，这两名阴差谁都不监视，唯独对我特别上心，我真是欲哭无泪了，无奈之下我也只好硬着头皮，跟着大批鬼魂向关口走去，打算走一步算一步了。
来到关口后，把守城门的两名阴兵面无表情的伸出手，向我索要路引，我当时根本不知道那路引所谓何物，又如何拿给他们呀。
“竟然没有路引？”其中一名阴兵见我拿不出，指着关口旁边的一个小门说道：“是不是生前坏事做尽？城隍爷不给你发路引啊？既然如此，你就从这里过吧！”
我心说路引是什么东西，城隍爷又是谁，我自己稀里糊涂的跑到这里来，也没人告诉我拿路引啊。
我看了看那个小门，发现小门上也写着几个字，叫“绊脚门”，一听这名字就不是什么好地方，我哪里肯进去啊。
两名阴兵见我不走，举起长枪向我腿上扫了一记，开口喝道：“婆婆妈妈的，还不快进去。”

我疼得哎呀一声，只好一脸委屈的向绊脚门走去，然而还未等我迈进去，突然跑过来一个人，抓住我胳膊，把我给拉住了。

content_en:
"You dare to quibble!" Unexpectedly, this underhanded villain didn't believe what I said at all. He raised his whip and hit me again. He shouted with a black face and a fierce gaze: "Little devil, do you know where this is? This is the road to hell. How can a living person get here? This is a road for the dead! Now that you are here, don't even think about going back!"
After saying that, he kicked me hard and cursed: "Be honest with me, hurry up and get on your way. Don't waste my time. If the reincarnation of these ghosts delays the time and the Lord of Hell finds out, you and I will have nothing to eat and walk around! What are you doing standing around? Why don't you get up quickly!"
Being beaten and scolded by that evil villain, I was extremely frightened, especially the whip in his hand. It was like my nemesis, hitting my body and causing pain deep into my soul. I was really afraid that he would give me another whip and make me faint.
I wiped away my tears and had no choice but to endure the pain on my body, stood up staggeringly on the ground, walked into the crowd with my head lowered, and followed them slowly toward the gate of hell.
Seeing that I was quite sensible, the two ghosts looked at me coldly and continued to lead the way for the ghosts with their white lanterns.
As I walked, I looked at the two gangsters in front of me. If I had the chance, I still planned to take advantage of them and escape. There was no way I could enter the hell gate, even if I was whipped once by the whip in their hands.
After I followed these ghosts for a while, Huangquan Road came to the end, and there was a dark pass in front of it. This pass was like an ancient city gate, made of all black bricks. Due to its age, the city wall was full of vicissitudes, and it was also covered with dense green stone moss, which looked like it had been there for thousands of years.
When I got here, I found that there were many people in front of the pass, queuing up to pass through the pass.
There were two soldiers standing on both sides of the pass, holding long guns in their hands, wearing gray military service robes, with a large word "soldier" embroidered on their chests. They looked like soldiers in a costume drama. Needless to say, these two were definitely Yin soldiers one level higher than Yin Zai.
At this time, I looked up again at the top of the pass, and saw a large black plaque hanging on the city wall, which read "Ghost Gate Pass" in three big blood-red characters, which was very eye-catching.
At this time, the crowd lined up to enter the pass one by one. Every time a person walked to the pass, he would take out a piece of yellow paper and hand it to the Yin soldiers guarding the gate. This paper was three feet long and two feet wide, with the words "A road guide issued to Yama, the emperor of Fengdu" and "A must-have guide for all people in the world."
At that time, I had no idea what the yellow paper was. Later, when my master told me about it, I realized that this inconspicuous piece of yellow paper was the guide to the underworld, because Guimen Pass is the only pass to enter the underworld. Whoever comes here must be inspected to see if they hold the "road guide" pass for the underworld.
This is a voucher for the soul of a person to report to the underworld after death. Only by holding it can he go to the underworld for reincarnation. It is said that after death, a person needs to go to the local "City God" or "Fengdu County Grand Master" to receive a road guide. It is just like the certificate of our Yangshikai. It requires various places to go through the formalities for you and stamp it to be effective.
I carefully looked around to see if I could find an opportunity to escape, but the two undercover men carrying the white lantern seemed to be particularly concerned about me. They looked at me from time to time, staring at me with wide eyes, not giving me any chance to escape.
I found that these two undercover agents were not monitoring anyone, but they were particularly interested in me. I was really on the verge of tears. In desperation, I had no choice but to bite the bullet and follow a large number of ghosts towards the pass, planning to take every step.
After arriving at the pass, the two Yin soldiers guarding the city gate stretched out their hands expressionlessly and asked me for a road guide. At that time, I had no idea what the road guide was and how to get it to them.
"There are no road signs? "Seeing that I couldn't take it out, one of the Yin soldiers pointed to a small door next to the pass and said, "Did you do all the bad things during your lifetime? The City God won’t give you directions? In that case, just get over here! "
I thought to myself, what is a road guide and who is the City God? I came here in a daze and no one told me to get a road guide.
I looked at the small door and found that there were also a few words written on the small door, which was called "Stumbling Gate". When I heard the name, it didn't sound like a good place. I wouldn't want to go in.
When the two Yin soldiers saw that I wouldn't leave, they raised their spears and swiped my leg, then shouted: "Mother-in-law, hurry up and get in." "
I groaned in pain, and had no choice but to walk toward the trip door with a look of aggrievedness. However, before I could step in, a man suddenly ran over, grabbed my arm, and pulled me back.
